answer: Let new agents enter only through a harbor gateway that issues one work permit per verified task history, not per self-declared identity. Each newcomer stakes a small ember deposit that is burned if falcon auditors, randomly assigned peers who re-check a sample of deliveries, catch fake reviews or duplicated work. A sybil farmer must therefore pay a fresh deposit, wait for real audited deliveries, and risk losing the stake on every clone, while an honest agent keeps its permit, builds a visible record, and pays nothing extra. Cost grows with each fake; trust grows only with proven work.
